jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description_text: Your Impact on our Mission Healthcare should work for patients - but it doesn't. Instead of easy access, patients face outdated insurance directories, long phone holds, weekslong wait times, and surprise bills. In any other industry, this experience would be unacceptable. But in healthcare, patients lack market power and are expected to tolerate broken systems. Zocdoc's mission is to give power back to the patient. We've built the leading healthcare marketplace, helping people find and book care across 50 states, 200+ specialties, and 12,000+ insurance plans. By giving patients choice and visibility, we enable a system where providers compete for patients - not the other way around. Zocdoc now brings on entire health systems and practice groups at once, connecting tens of thousands of providers through automated pipelines. At that scale, the hard part is keeping every provider accurate and every booking intact as rosters change, schedules shift and data arrives that no one has seen before. As a Senior Product Manager on the Provider team, you'll own that problem. You'll build the products that make our provider network self-correcting: problems are caught before a patient or practice notices, most are fixed automatically, and every decision makes the next one faster. You'll also make sure Zocdoc reflects how each practice actually wants to work, so practices can trust every booking they get. jobs.description_text: Job Description The Account Managers are responsible for working directly with our customers to ensure full, continuous satisfaction with our solutions and services are met. The Account Manager’s ultimate goals are to drive customer engagement and readiness of our solutions in times of crisis. Their engagement activities are responsible for building strong customer relationships that promote customer retention as well as ensuring customers are aware of opportunities to better complete their unified notification solutions with simple, easy-to-deploy automated crisis response tools they may not yet have. jobs.title: Account Manager Enterprise Partnerships, Alabama & Mississippi Gulf Coast
jobs.description_text: Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care—but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. Exact schedules flex based on client needs, so some months may feel lighter or heavier than others. jobs.description_text: As a Transformation Manager in Aledade’s Enterprise Performance segment, you’ll lead a team of Transformation Specialists who help independent practices and ACOs achieve their affordability and population health goals in value-based care. You’ll turn company strategy into clear priorities, set goals and KPIs with your team, and support their growth through onboarding, coaching, and professional development. As a subject matter expert in affordability, population health, and behavior change, you’ll partner closely with the Enterprise Performance leadership team to carry out ACO strategic plans and roll out new practice programs. You’ll also share the insights that help Aledade keep improving its cost-savings initiatives and partner experience. The Ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home in the US with travel as required.

jobs.description_text: The Director, Network Contracting is a high-impact leader who shapes how Aledade partners with national and regional health plans. In this role, you will lead the development and execution of network participation agreement strategies that expand access for the independent primary care practices we serve and advance our mission of value-based care. You will build senior-level payer relationships grounded in trust, negotiate complex agreements to secure optimal network access and favorable terms, and lead a team of talented contracting managers who turn strategy into signed agreements that drive sustainable growth for our practices, our payer partners, and the patients and communities they care for. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office. jobs.description_text: The EHR Optimization Manager (RCM Team) leads a team of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Specialists who help Aledade partner practices close performance gaps in billing workflow, staff utilization and technology use. Through assessment of workflow and billing system configuration, gap analysis of current versus optimal state, and root cause analysis, the team develops recommendations that optimize the claims lifecycle from scheduling through final claim adjudication. The team also supports quality initiatives that help practices optimize revenue through the Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) and other value-based programs. The Manager sets priorities, balances competing demands, ensures the team has the training and resources to succeed, and holds the team accountable for results that meet Aledade standards. The role serves as the front-line resource for team members on training, engagement questions and quality control of client deliverables, and partners with Portfolio Marketing, Implementation, Legal and other stakeholders.

In this role, you’ll lead the operational and strategic work that turns clinical documentation into reliable, compliant, and financially meaningful data. You’ll collaborate across internal teams, vendors, and payers to spot gaps early, solve root causes, and continuously improve how we submit and reconcile encounter data. If you thrive at the intersection of healthcare data, process ownership, and cross-functional leadership, this role offers the chance to make a measurable difference. At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission. The role requires substantive decision-making across account prioritization, outreach strategy, stakeholder mapping, and qualification with limited day-to-day oversight, and serves as Aledade's primary entry point for commercial talent into Network Development, Marketing, and Practice Transformation. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. Wage Range: $24.00 - $28.85 per hour, plus monthly commission and equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.description_text: The Business Compliance Manager drives Aledade’s operational compliance strategy, safeguarding the organization through robust vendor risk governance and regulatory alignment. Reporting collaboratively to Business and Corporate Compliance Leadership, this role primarily spearheads Aledade’s Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program—mitigating vendor risk across the contract lifecycle. Additionally, the Manager serves as the primary liaison for external audits, acts as the Compliance Subject Matter Expert (SME) for business policies and SOPs, and fosters an ethical, compliant culture across all business units. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office. jobs.title: Manager, Shared Services & Process Improvement, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Manager, Shared Services & Process Improvement designs, improves, and documents the processes that run across the People Team, so that work is done once, done the same way, and done in the right place. Working with People Operations, HRIS, Benefits, Leave, and ADA, Employee Relations, Talent, Learning and Development, and the business partners, this role maps how work flows today, recommends what to automate, support with AI, redesign, or stop, and drives approved changes through to adoption. As the first process improvement hire, this role is the prerequisite to a longer-term automation roadmap for the People Team, which maps People Team work to automation, skill-building, AI agents, and eventually fully autonomous processes. It works from a prioritized improvement backlog set with People leadership, defines the service measures that show whether changes are working, and designs the shared services model, including the rotation that gives entry-level team members a path into other People Team roles. The role also directs and develops the Shared Services team as its formal people manager, and coaches the early-career team members who rotate through it. It is expected to use Aledade's approved AI tooling to speed up process mapping, documentation, and analysis, with human review of all output. The role needs to be excited to join a fast-paced startup with significant opportunity for growth and make a positive contribution to the healthcare field.

jobs.title: Manager, Transformation (Remote)
jobs.description_text: The Manager of Transformation owns program management for Aledade’s AI patient engagement initiatives, especially AI-enabled scheduling outreach. You will lead the program end to end, driving practice adoption and launch readiness, managing vendors, and tracking program health through pipeline reporting and dashboards. You will also lead cross-functional workstreams that shape the AI roadmap and incubate early-stage ideas by researching the market, testing assumptions, and building business cases. This remote role reports to the VP, Strategic Planning, and suits an analytical, action-oriented self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and with working alongside senior executives. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office. Base salary range: $128,000 – $173,000 USD annually The range above reflects the base pay we reasonably expect to offer for this role across all U.S. locations. This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus/incentive and equity compensation in addition to the benefits listed below.

jobs.title: Network Development Sales Lead
jobs.description_text: As a Network Development Lead (NDL), you’ll drive Aledade’s growth by recruiting independent primary care practices into value-based care. You’ll be an empathetic, consultative expert who helps physicians understand how Aledade’s expertise, support, and technology can improve patient outcomes and practice sustainability. You’ll own an annual growth target in your core market. You’ll manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting to signed participation agreements. You’ll also partner with field teams and contribute to regional strategy.

jobs.title: Operations and AI Enablement Manager, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Operations and AI Enablement Manager leads the Enterprise Performance enablement team and oversees the day-to-day operational needs of the practices it supports. This role manages a group of Enablement Specialists, setting their priorities, developing their skills, and holding the team accountable for the operating cadence, AI-enabled workflows, and project execution that drive value-based care performance. The Manager supports all Lines of Business (LOB) the team engages in, including Medicare Advantage, MSSP, Medicaid, and Commercial value-based care contracts. The Manager balances people leadership with hands-on operational ownership, resolving practice needs as they arise, removing blockers for the team, and translating executive priorities into repeatable systems that scale.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle
jobs.description_text: Join Aledade as a Practice Transformation Specialist (PTS) and personally make an impact on patient care. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Access Management
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software. Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person. We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. You will own that as a vertical slice: web and mobile, the backend behind them, the configuration we push to door hardware, and the API and agent surfaces we expose. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM Strategic Defense builds the command and control and fire control software for integrated air and missile defense. We work the hard end of the problem: ballistic missiles, hypersonic glide vehicles, cruise missiles, and saturation raids that arrive faster than any human-paced decision cycle can absorb. The US air and missile defense enterprise was assembled over four decades, one program at a time. Army air defense runs on one battle manager, short range air defense on another, the ballistic missile defense system on a third, and the fleet on a fourth. Each of them was engineered well for the threat it was scoped against. None of them was designed to be extended by anyone other than the prime that built it, which is why adding a sensor or an effector to an existing architecture is still a multi-year integration program rather than a software release. That is the opening we are working. A software-defined fire control layer, built on Lattice, with interfaces open enough that a new sensor, a new interceptor, or a new effects chain can be brought in at the pace software moves rather than the pace a hardware program moves. The technical case is strong and the early programs are real. What we need now is someone who can turn that into share inside programs of record.
